about: Special (magic), template-only and connection variables of ansible-core 2.18 (docs: reference_appendices/special_variables).

ansible_check_mode.description: True when the playbook runs in check mode (--check).

ansible_collection_name.description: Collection of the current role, if any.

ansible_config_file.description: Path of the ansible.cfg in use.

ansible_connection.description: Connection plugin used for the host, e.g. ssh or local.

ansible_dependent_role_names.description: Names of the roles imported as dependencies of the current role.

ansible_diff_mode.description: True when the playbook runs in diff mode (--diff).

ansible_facts.description: The facts gathered for the current host (setup and other fact modules).

ansible_failed_result.description: The result of the task that failed and triggered the current rescue section.

ansible_failed_task.description: The task that failed and triggered the current rescue section.

ansible_forks.description: Number of forks available to this run.

ansible_host.description: Address to connect to, when it differs from the inventory name.

ansible_index_var.description: Name of the loop_control.index_var of the current loop.

ansible_inventory_sources.description: The inventory sources of this run.

ansible_loop_var.description: Name of the loop_control.loop_var of the current loop.

ansible_managed.description: The DEFAULT_MANAGED_STR marker text for generated files.

ansible_parent_role_names.description: Names of the roles that included the current role, innermost first.

ansible_parent_role_paths.description: Paths of the roles that included the current role, innermost first.

ansible_play_batch.description: Hosts of the current play batch (serial), without failed or unreachable ones.

ansible_play_hosts.description: Hosts of the current play that are still active.

ansible_play_hosts_all.description: Every host the current play targets.

ansible_play_name.description: Name of the play that is running.

ansible_play_role_names.description: Names of the roles the current play applies (without dependencies).

ansible_playbook_python.description: Path of the Python interpreter that runs ansible-playbook.

ansible_python_interpreter.description: Python interpreter on the managed host.

ansible_role_name.description: Fully qualified name of the current role.

ansible_role_names.description: Names of the roles the current play applies, dependencies included.

ansible_search_path.description: Paths searched for files, templates and lookups.

ansible_ssh_common_args.description: Extra arguments for ssh, scp and sftp.

ansible_ssh_private_key_file.description: Private key file of the SSH connection.

ansible_verbosity.description: The verbosity level of this run.

group_names.description: Groups the current host belongs to (without all and ungrouped).

groups.description: Every inventory group with its hosts.

hostvars.description: The variables of every inventory host, by host name.

inventory_dir.description: Directory of the inventory source that defined the current host.

inventory_file.description: The inventory source that defined the current host.

inventory_hostname.description: Inventory name of the current host.

inventory_hostname_short.description: Inventory name of the current host up to the first dot.

omit.description: Special value: an option set to omit is left out of the module call.

play_hosts.description: Hosts of the current play batch.

playbook_dir.description: Directory of the playbook that is running.

role_names.description: Names of the roles the current play applies.

template_destpath.description: Destination path of the file being rendered.

template_fullpath.description: Absolute path of the template being rendered.

template_host.description: Name of the machine that renders the template.

template_path.description: Path of the template being rendered.

template_run_date.description: Date and time of the render.
